name: skillsmith
description: Agent skills by Atou4, one plugin per pack: meta skills for managing skills, a UI/UX bundle, and engineering workflows. Install only the packs you want.

plugins.name: skillsmith
plugins.description: Meta skills for managing agent skills: vet, install, audit, sync and update-check them, and route project work to the right skill.

plugins.name: ui-ux
